أحبب (form I)
# أَحْبِبْ (ʔaḥbib) /ʔaħ.bib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# أُحْبَبْ (ʔuḥbab) /ʔuħ.bab/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of حَبَّ (ḥabba) and حُبَّ (ḥubba)
# أَحْبُبْ (ʔaḥbub) /ʔaħ.bub/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# أَحْبَبْ (ʔaḥbab) /ʔaħ.bab/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of حَبَّ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
